summary: This guide covers strategy for the Piece of Treasury gear forging event in Season 9. The creator explains his methodology for choosing which mythic equipment pieces to forge based on gear carried over from previous seasons and upcoming banner heroes. He emphasizes prioritizing armor over gloves since gloves can easily hit critical rate caps through artifacts and runes. He also considers whether to build for an Aura team or continue focusing on Dauntless depending on the performance of upcoming exclusive Aura banner units like Anneliesis.

meta_changes: Piece of Treasury event now occurs twice per season, enabling players to forge more custom mythic equipment over time.
Precise Carnage set remains the most consistent and versatile mythic gear set with superior longevity across seasons.
tips: Wait until daily dungeon stages unlock before forging, as you might get lucky with standard drops and save forge resources for other slots.
Prioritize forging armor chests over gloves with Crit Damage substats, because critical rate is easily capped via artifacts and runes.
Alternate gear forging targets between seasons (e.g., focus on one element/archetype per season) so carryover gear remains optimal.
When forging Carnage armor for HP-scaling DPS like Talethia, select HP% main stat and invest all upgrade rolls into Crit Damage.
